name: Godhood
description:
You have gathered enough devotional power within yourself to achieve godhood.

  • You become undying and do not age.

  • Multiply your base Endurance by your Devotion score.

  • Double your base Hope and Defense.

  • Halve all non-magical damage dealt to you.

  • You may grant +1d bonuses to any creature a number of times per day equal to their Devotion score. The creature must be acting within your domain or be a worshipper of you.

  • You may phase in, phase out, alter your appearance to any form within your domain, or teleport to the location of one of your shrines or devotees a number of times per day equal to your Devotion score, divided by 10.

  • You can always sense when you are receiving devotion, as well as when one of your devotees or shrines is in danger.

  • If you would be killed outright, you are instead reduced to a powerless, incorporeal being and you lose this ability.

  • Whenever you would gain XP, halve it. All XP costs are doubled for you.

Describe how godhood manifests in you.
